34:t_002:10.en:
$$マリ$$
「We're in no position to worry about anything like that.」

34:t_002:11.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Have them hurry with Unit-01 too.」

34:t_002:12.en:
$$リツコ$$
「We are currently preparing to activate it with the Dummy System.」

34:t_002:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...Our target has not sortied? Then we need only smoke it out.」

34:t_002:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「All units, begin the attack! Destroy those two artificial humans and every last facility!」

34:t_002:16.en:
$$マリ$$
「So these are the aliens I've heard about... You may be running wild everywhere else, but I won't let you do it here...!」

34:t_003:0.en:
$$シゲル$$
「Contact directly overhead! $$サイデリアル$$'s jamming delayed detection!」

34:t_003:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「It has entered the $$ジオフロント$$! This is...!」

34:t_005:0.en:
$$シゲル$$
「Headquarters has taken a direct hit too!」

34:t_005:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「Its offensive power exceeds that of all previous Angels!」

34:t_005:2.en:
$$冬月$$
「$$第１０の使徒$$... The most powerful rejection type. Its destructive power is greater than we predicted...」

34:t_005:4.en:
$$マコト$$
「The Angel appears to be targeting $$サイデリアル$$ as well as the EVAs!」

34:t_005:5.en:
$$ミサト$$
「That should buy us a little time.」

34:t_005:6.en:
$$シゲル$$
「Are we using the Angel to stop $$サイデリアル$$?」

34:t_005:7.en:
$$ミサト$$
「The opposite. We'll use $$サイデリアル$$ as a breakwater to hold back the Angel.」

34:t_005:8.en:
$$ミサト$$
「If the Angel reaches $$セントラルドグマ$$, the world ends... We have to prevent that at any cost...」

34:t_005:9.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「General $$ダバラーン$$...! That monster is...」

34:t_005:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Heh... This planet is quite exciting...」

34:t_005:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That monster is a target as well! We will bring its corpse back as a gift for Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

34:t_005:13.en:
$$マリ$$
「The guests just keep coming. Oh dear, oh dear.」

34:t_005:15.en:
$$マリ$$
「Want to try calling Puppy for help?」

34:t_005:17.en:
$$マリ$$
「All right, all right. I'll stop the chatter and focus on fighting.」

34:t_009:1.en:
$$マヤ$$
「The core unit is rejecting the dummy! It's no good! EVA Unit-01 won't activate!」

34:t_009:3.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$$冬月$$, I'm counting on you... for a moment.」

34:t_010:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「...We can't win like this... All right, let's give it a try...」

34:t_010:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Show me the power of an EVA that's cast aside its humanity.」

34:t_010:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Mode inversion... Backdoor code... The Beast!」

34:t_011:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Ghh... ugh... uuugh...! Bear with it, $$ＥＶＡ２号機$$... I'll... bear with it too...!」

34:t_011:2.en:
$$マコト$$
「The EVAs had a function like that...!」

34:t_011:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「The limiters have been removed! All readings are beyond specifications!」

34:t_011:4.en:
$$マヤ$$
「We can't monitor the inside of the plug! But...!」

34:t_011:5.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The plug depth is probably negative... She doesn't even care about entering the contamination zone.」

34:t_011:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「Only... by... risking... your life... can you... find a way... through!!」

34:t_012:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Not yet! Not until I break through its entire $$Ａ．Ｔ．フィールド$$!」

34:t_014:1.en:
$$リツコ$$
「An EVA's second beast form... It can't win even after casting aside humanity and specializing in combat... Is this our limit...?」

34:t_016:4.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「$$Ａ．Ｔ．フィールド$$... at full power! Until... $$碇$$ comes... I'll do it...! So...!」

34:t_016:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'm not letting you hog all the glory!」

34:t_017:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「I've battered this borrowed Unit-02 so badly...! If I can't stop it now, I won't be able to face its real pilot!」

34:t_017:2.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Fools...! Have you forgotten we're here!?」

34:t_017:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「All units, attack! Wipe out that monster and those artificial humans!」

34:t_018:2.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「If we... break the $$Ａ．Ｔ．フィールド$$... the enemy's... attacks... will hit the Angel...! Then...!」

34:t_018:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Come on, shoot, aliens! You'll never beat the Angel or the EVAs with that!!」

34:t_019:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「It's no good...! Its regeneration is outpacing the damage!」
